sources.hero.title: Event Data Sources
sources.hero.desc: To ensure the reliability and accuracy of road information in Cochabamba, we aggregate, cross-reference, and validate information from multiple official entities, scientific sources, and direct neighborhood reports.
sources.grid.title: Active Data Sources
sources.grid.desc: Explore the entities that feed the Kocha Tracks database. Each report undergoes automatic and community processes to be classified.
sources.dataflow.title: Ingestion and Validation Flow
sources.dataflow.flow.step1.title: Multi-Channel Gathering
sources.dataflow.flow.step1.desc: Automatic ingestion via API, institutional web scraping, or direct geo-referenced reports from citizens in Cochabamba.
sources.dataflow.flow.step2.title: Civic Validation & Filters
sources.dataflow.flow.step2.desc: Cross-validation algorithms with Police Traffic reports and local community approval to prevent false reports or spam.
sources.dataflow.flow.step3.title: Map Publishing
sources.dataflow.flow.step3.desc: Instant synchronization on the interactive neighborhood map with early alerts and blockage-free route calculation.
sources.suggestions.title: Do you know another reliable source of information?
sources.suggestions.desc: Help us expand our alert coverage. If you know of any municipal API, structured neighborhood monitoring group, or official emergency channel in Cochabamba, please share it with us.

landing.hero.title: Monitor blocked routes without sharing your location
landing.hero.desc: Define areas of interest, receive alerts, and check incident history on the routes that matter to you in Bolivia. Total privacy guaranteed.
landing.map.title: Real-time map
landing.features.title: Why Kocha Tracks?
landing.features.desc: We built a civic tool focused on user privacy, information accuracy, and urban mobility analysis.
landing.features.card1.title: Custom Areas of Interest
landing.features.card1.desc: Define a point and radius or draw geographical areas to watch the routes that matter most without tracking your device.
landing.features.card2.title: Alerts Without Active GPS
landing.features.card2.desc: Receive notifications for newly blocked roads or changes without needing to keep GPS running in the background.
landing.features.card3.title: Incident History
landing.features.card3.desc: Check when an incident began, how long it lasted, when it was resolved, and what other past events occurred to understand temporal patterns in your city.
landing.steps.title: How it works
landing.steps.step1.title: Define your zones
landing.steps.step1.desc: Set up your daily routes or areas of interest without mapping your actual position.
landing.steps.step2.title: Receive alerts
landing.steps.step2.desc: Early alerts of disruptions or status updates straight to your feed.
landing.steps.step3.title: Check history
landing.steps.step3.desc: Compare recurrence, critical hours, and past resolution times.
landing.cta.title: Start monitoring your routes today
landing.cta.desc: Join the citizen mobility monitoring network in Cochabamba and Bolivia. Stay informed with complete privacy.
landing.cta.note: Does not require continuous active GPS. Completely free and open.
